title: Oil stabilizes as Middle East attacks offset supply surplus
html:
J Studios/DigitalVision via Getty Images

Oil prices steadied after two weeks of declines as renewed attacks in the Middle East tempered concerns about excess supply. Brent (CO1:COM) traded below $96 a barrel following a weekly loss exceeding 2%, while West Texas Intermediate (
summary: Oil prices steady below $96 for Brent as Middle East attacks revive shipping risks, while the IEA sees a 2 million b/d supply surplus.
